capital.evidence_quote: Bandar Seri Begawan is the capital and royal seat of the Sultanate of Brunei Darussalam

currency.evidence_quote: The Brunei Dollar (BND) is pegged 1:1 with the Singapore Dollar; SGD is interchangeable and legal tender

timezone.evidence_quote: Brunei Darussalam operates on UTC+8 year-round without seasonal clock changes

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Brunei is 240V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The national alternating power grid operating frequency is standard 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: British standard Type G rectangular three-pin plugs and sockets are universal throughout Brunei

police.evidence_quote: Dial 993 for emergency police response throughout Brunei

sources.title: Ministry of Health Emergency Medical Ambulance Services

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 991 for national emergency medical dispatch and hospital ambulance transport

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 995 for emergency fire and rescue services

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourism Development Department in Bandar Seri Begawan assists visitors at +673 238 0022

advisory_headline.tr: Brunei Sultanlığı dünyanın en huzurlu ve düşük suç oranına sahip ülkelerindendir; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Brunei Darussalam is exceptionally peaceful with very low crime; exercise standard travel precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Brunei ist ein sehr sicheres und friedliches Sultanat; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Бруней — одно из самых спокойных и безопасных государств мира; действуют обычные правила.
advisory_headline.es: Brunéi es un sultanato sumamente pacífico, seguro y ordenado; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Brunei exceed 82.0 Mbps with nationwide 5G

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Brunei measure 75.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: DST, Progresif, and imagine provide prepaid tourist SIMs at Brunei International Airport (BWN). Visitors must complete the digital E-Arrival Card (imm.gov.bn) prior to arrival.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: SIM card registration requires valid passport verification under AITI telecommunications rules

religion.value: Islam (approx. 82% official religion, Sunni Shafi'i jurisprudence), Buddhism (approx. 7%), and Christianity (approx. 7%)

sources.title: Department of Economic Planning and Statistics Brunei

religion.evidence_quote: The national philosophy of Melayu Islam Beraja (Malay Islamic Monarchy) defines moral and civic life

festivals.value: His Majesty the Sultan's Birthday (July 15 with fireworks and royal audiences), National Day (Feb 23), Hari Raya Aidilfitri, Chinese New Year
festivals.evidence_quote: During Hari Raya Aidilfitri, the Istana Nurul Iman royal palace opens its doors to the public for three days

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Alcohol sales and public consumption are strictly prohibited nationwide. Non-Muslim adult travelers may import up to 2 bottles of liquor (up to 2 liters total) and 12 cans of beer for private consumption only, declared on arrival. Dress modestly with shoulders and knees covered in public. Friday noon prayers (12:00-14:00) require all commercial businesses to close.

sources.title: Royal Customs and Excise Department Brunei

legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Non-Muslims entering Brunei must declare personal alcohol allowances under Customs regulations

tipping.value: Tipping is not customary in Brunei as a 10% service charge is included in upscale restaurant and hotel bills.
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is not expected as standard service charge is included in invoices
